done_when: A review no longer finds: Native rounds ignore local model overrides when selecting a subagent role
why: Review finding left open by FORGE-TOOLS-1/WORK: Native rounds ignore local model overrides when selecting a subagent role (src/forge/worker.py:125): Raise: Functional. `forge work` uses the model from `repo.config(top)` and prints it for the native round, but the `worker`, `fixer`, and `frontend` role files are generated from shared `forge.toml` settings. `sync.files` at src/forge/sync.py:364 explicitly removes `forge.local.toml` overrides before generating those files. When a developer sets a documented local model override, Forge prints that model while the instructed subagent role runs on the shared model. The native work test never supplies a local override, so it misses this mismatch.
